Title: Azure Batch Job/Pool Lifetime Statistics API will be retired on 30 April 2023

Body.Content:
Because more advanced ways of log/job/pool data can be collected and used on a need basis using Azure portal logs, alerts, log export, and other additional methods, we’ll retire Batch Job/Pool Lifetime Statistics API on 30 April 2023. See the guide for more information. 

Required Action 

Stop using Batch Job/Pool Lifetime Statistics API by 30 April 2023. After that, we’ll stop supporting the API. The API will cease to work and will return an appropriate HTTP response error code back to the client.

Help and Support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
